title: J.D. LaRock:
headline: Strangers stop J.D. on the street to say NFTE changed their life.
story: Alison asked for J.D.'s answer to: what moment made you realize this approach is working? His proof is people. Alumni from 10, 15, 20 years ago still tell him NFTE changed the direction of their life. One even stopped him on the street.
Open on the street story, because it is the most human line. Then the proof, then the smile. It must feel warm, proud and hopeful.

Keep the numbers "10, 15, 20 years" exactly as he says them.
